hint: tap anywhere to plant a seed

game.q: the end of the world begins. you’re holding a sapling. now what?
opts: take one last photo of it

wrong.later: there is no later. plant it.

game.right: YES. “let him plant it.” a steward keeps tending to the very last minute.

end.line: the earth isn’t ours. it’s a trust, and a steward keeps planting to the very end.
end.l2: keep tending it to the very end.

share: before earth, a conversation. even the angels asked. a story in the qur’an, on infinite hill
